verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official MCP server documented at firebase.google.com/docs/ai-assistance/mcp-server, explicitly compatible with common MCP clients (Claude Code/Desktop, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Cline, Windsurf, Antigravity) and exposing capabilities like managing Firebase projects, Auth, Firestore, and messaging. This is first-party documentation confirming a working, general-purpose MCP server integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server's real-world reliability.
